_comment: Runs on a personal machine via a real Chromium (Playwright) - no Apify, no cost. A residential IP is necessary but not sufficient: both sites also check that the client is a real browser, so a plain HTTP GET fails on any connection.
_browser: headless false opens a visible window - slower, but it is the fallback when Kasada refuses the headless one. browser_channel null means 'try your installed Chrome first, fall back to the bundled Chromium'; force one with 'chrome' or 'chromium'.
